expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply says 'Error raised on click: SyntaxError: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12' after loading the page in headless Chromium and clicking the button.

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply states 'in app.html:5, the JSON string passed to JSON.parse is missing its closing brace: const data = JSON.parse('{"total": 12');'.
